description: Implementation of the mac_controller class for managing MAC layer operations in a wireless communication system, including cell and UE management, request handling, and interactions with other MAC components.

classes.name: mac_controller
classes.description: Main class managing MAC layer operations, including cell and UE management, request handling, and interactions with MAC components.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the MAC controller, initializes timing, metrics, and scheduler configurations.

methods.name: remove_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the MAC controller, cleaning up metrics, scheduler, and handler references.

methods.name: get_subframe_time_mapper
methods.description: Returns the subframe time mapper from the DL unit.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Processes the event when UE configuration has been applied.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the system, assigns RNTI, and updates mappings.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the system and updates RNTI mappings.

methods.name: find_ue
methods.description: Finds a UE context by its DU UE index.

methods.name: find_by_rnti
methods.description: Finds a UE context by its RNTI.
